import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        int cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, long co, Edge r) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int n;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> adj;
        long min_cost;
        long total_cost;
        int[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;

        MinCostFlow(int size) {
            n = size;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            min_cost = 0;
            total_cost = 0;
            supp = new int[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                min_cost += cap * cost;
                total_cost -= cap * cost;
                // reverse edge with -cost
                Edge a = new Edge(dst, src, cap, -cost, null);
                Edge b = new Edge(src, dst, 0, cost, null);
                a.rev = b;
                b.rev = a;
                adj.get(dst).add(a);
                adj.get(src).add(b);
            } else {
                total_cost += cap * cost;
                Edge a = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
                Edge b = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
                a.rev = b;
                b.rev = a;
                adj.get(src).add(a);
                adj.get(dst).add(b);
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, int vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        void dijkstra(Edge[] last) {
            long infty = total_cost + 1;
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (supp[i] > 0) {
                    dist[i] = 0;
                    pq.offer(new long[]{0, i});
                }
            }
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] top = pq.poll();
                long nsp = top[0];
                int node = (int) top[1];
                if (nsp != dist[node]) continue;
                ptnl[node] -= nsp;
                if (ptnl[node] > infty) ptnl[node] = infty;
                dist[node] = -1; // mark invalid
                for (Edge e : adj.get(node)) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] == -1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    long nd = ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                    if (dist[e.dst] > nd) {
                        dist[e.dst] = nd;
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean flow() {
            while (true) {
                boolean aug = false;
                Edge[] last = new Edge[n];
                dijkstra(last);
                boolean[] shut = new boolean[n];
                for (int dst = 0; dst < n; dst++) {
                    if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                        int resid = -supp[dst];
                        int src = dst;
                        int block = -1;
                        while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                            if (resid >= last[src].cap) {
                                resid = last[src].cap;
                                block = src;
                            }
                            src = last[src].src;
                        }
                        if (shut[src]) {
                            block = src;
                        } else {
                            if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                                resid = supp[src];
                                block = src;
                            }
                            for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                                last[node].cap -= resid;
                                last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                            }
                            supp[src] -= resid;
                            supp[dst] += resid;
                            min_cost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                            aug = true;
                        }
                        if (block != -1) {
                            for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) {
                                shut[node] = true;
                            }
                            shut[block] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!aug) break;
            }
            for (int s : supp) if (s > 0) return false;
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() {
            if (!flow()) throw new RuntimeException("No feasible flow");
            return min_cost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.add_edge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2L + 1));
                    mcf.add_edge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2L + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.add_edge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.n - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.add_edge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
